<?php
/** Automatically stage Popup Siege on the disposable Playground demo. */
add_action(
	'admin_enqueue_scripts',
	static function () {
		if ( ! function_exists( 'openstation_is_enabled' ) || ! openstation_is_enabled() ) {
			return;
		}
		wp_add_inline_script(
			'openstation',
			'window.wp.os.ready(function(){var games=window.wp.os.games;if(games&&typeof games.launch==="function"){Promise.resolve(games.launch("popup-siege")).catch(function(){window.wp.os.openWindow("desktop-mode-games",{source:"popup-siege-demo"});});}else{window.wp.os.openWindow("desktop-mode-games",{source:"popup-siege-demo"});}});',
			'after'
		);
	},
	100
);
